def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_income = 875
    depreciation = 400
    increase_accounts_receivable = 800 - 750
    increase_inventories = 850 - 720
    increase_accounts_payable = 400 - 300
    increase_accrued_expenses = 120 - 90
    capital_expenditures = 5000 - 4250
    net_debt_issued = (550 - 500) + (1500 - 1400)

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    cash_from_operations = (
        net_income
        + depreciation
        - increase_accounts_receivable
        - increase_inventories
        + increase_accounts_payable
        + increase_accrued_expenses
    )
    answer = cash_from_operations - capital_expenditures + net_debt_issued

    # Return answer rounded to one decimal place
    return round(answer, 1)
